sections.text: Protection

Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:
 Over Current Relay

MCGG 
 62
 GEC
Introduction

The document is formatted the way to minimize the 
possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.

The MCGG 62 is single, two, three or four pole over 
current relay, Each pole of the relay provides a choice of four IDMT 
characteristics and three definite time characteristics. Additionally, each pole 
is provided with an instantaneous high-set element which can be disabled if not 
required. The MCGG 62 relay is Three phase with instantaneous elements Over 
current protection Relay This procedure details the steps required to completely 
check the proper operation and calibration of the MCGG62 relay. It is 
recommended this procedure to be carried out on an annually bases.

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. 
Medhat Magdy Gerges, revised by eng. 
Abdel-Naser Moustafa Ahmed, accepted by eng. Shawky Attalla: general manager, approved by eng. Abdel Elmegeed Emara: head sector of SIDI KRIR 
Power Station, 
and certified by eng. Mona 
Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer 'A' and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety helmet, safety shoes ... ets

Outage 
 arrangement must be done

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Relays Preparation
Review the manual and drawings.

Carefully follow these test procedure 
steps
Check the wires of the relay by hand.

Check the AC source is available to the 
tester.

Check the existence of the DC sources in 
panels.

Disconnect the trip leads of the relay 
and connect one of them to the timer of the tester.
Check all the leads used in tests.

Make sure CT secondary circuits are 
shorted at the incoming terminal blocks before isolating the relay current 
circuits for test.

sections.text: Power Supply Test

Press the RESET button and check that all LEDs are illuminated. This confirms 
that all measuring boards are operating satisfactorily

sections.text:
Current Pick-up 
and Reset Check Test

Connect 
test lead between the current terminal on the relay for phase R as shown in drawing and the current terminals 
on the test set.

Slowly increase the current until the green 
LED lights. The relay must operate with a current between +/- 10% of the setting 
value.
Record this value on the test sheet.

Slowly decrease the current until the green 
LED reset.
Record this value on the test sheet.
Repeat this steps for phase S and phase T

sections.text:
Time Setting 
Test

Connect the relay time delayed output 
contacts to the timer contacts of the test set.

Switch on the test set and inject current. 
The timer will stop after delay time(1.3sec).
Record this value on the test sheet.
Repeat this steps for phase S and phase T

items:
Inject current into the relay and increase it to reach (5 Is) . Keep this 
 value and switch off the test set.

Connect the relay time delayed output 
contacts to the timer contacts of the test set.

Switch on the test set and inject current. 
The timer will stop after delay time(1.3sec).
Record this value on the test sheet.
Repeat this steps for phase S and phase T

sections.text:
Instantaneous 
Setting Test

Connect the instantaneous trip out put 
contacts to the timer contacts on the test set. This is to stop the current as 
soon as the relay picks up.

CAUTION: Do not keep this current on the 
relay for more than a few seconds as it may exceed the rating and damage the 
relay.
Decrease the setting of Is to 0.1 In.

Increase current quickly to 
reach (11 Is). Keep this value and switch off the test set.

Connect the relay trip output contacts to 
the timer contacts of the test set.

Switch on the test set and inject current. 
The timer will stop instantaneous (50ms).
Record this value on the test sheet.
Repeat this steps for phase S and phase T

sections.text: Trip Test

items:
Request the 
 operator to switch on the main circuit breaker.

Operate the output auxiliary contact by injection to 
 trip the circuit breaker.
Check that the circuit breaker tripped.

sections.text:
Return the Relay 
and Power Equipment to Service

Verify the test result match the relay 
setting. If not consult technical services.

Test trip the circuit breaker associated 
with the relay.

Make a final check that all switches on the 
relay are set according to the setting sheet.

Make sure the CT secondary circuit is in 
normal condition

Remove the CT shorts which were installed in 
the Power Supply

Return the relay and power equipment to 
service.
